answer.rationale: Regional failover (memory_b2) has a proven track record of rapidly restoring latency during degradation with clean traffic shifting and fast error rate recovery. Given the 90-minute climbing write latency at peak settlement traffic and the impossibility of rollback due to the mandatory security patch, this offers the fastest path to recovery. While add_capacity (memory_b3) helped with pre-peak provisioning, we are already at peak and need immediate action. Circuit breakers and read replicas are less directly applicable to the write path latency issue. Compliance is maintained by failing over to regions with the same security-patched release.
